newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil charters new oil, product vessels.
newsitem.headline: Statoil charters new oil, product vessels.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) has secured new tonnage under construction by two Norwegian shipping companies, the company's Status Weekly newsletter said on Thursday.
Statoil has fixed a 126,000-tonne shuttle tanker from Knutsen OAS for three years with options for extensions.
The vessel is under construction at Spain's Sestao yard near Bilbao for delivery next July and will be able to load 870,000 barrels. It will be used in shuttle traffic offshore Norway.
Stenersen in Bergen will charter a 14,000-tonne product carrier to Statoil for work on the Norwegian continental shelf from 1998. The ship is due to be built in Shanghai.
Options for the vessel and a further carrier were included in the charter party, Statoil said.
